result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: restaurant metadata text overlaps and becomes hard to read.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the metadata line under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' appears visually overlapped: the delivery time and delivery fee text collide, making the line difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the metadata row layout to use proper spacing or a flex layout with separators, and ensure each text element has enough width to avoid overlap.
